definitions.gloss: way of working; work style; how one works
definitions.explanation: The manner, style, or approach a person or organization takes toward work.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: To reconsider one's way of working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な{働|はたら}き{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Diverse work styles are being sought.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}{時間|じかん}→残業時間：27558_zangyoujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: Work style reform established an upper limit on overtime hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦リモートワーク→リモートワーク：06095_rimootowaaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{働|はたら}き{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The spread of remote work greatly changed how people work.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work) and ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way, manner). This word gained enormous prominence in Japan with the government's {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく} (Work Style Reform) initiative launched in 2018, which addressed long working hours, non-regular employment, and work-life balance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}: work style reform
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{働|はたら}き{方|かた}: new way of working
- ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な{働|はたら}き{方|かた}: diverse work styles
- ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧な{働|はたら}き{方|かた}: flexible work style
- {働|はたら}き{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change one's work style

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's Work Style Reform Act ({働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}{関連|かんれん}{法|ほう}) was a landmark labor reform that introduced caps on overtime, mandated paid leave, and promoted equal pay for equal work. The term {働|はたら}き{方|かた} now carries strong connotations of modernization and flexibility in the Japanese workplace.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勤務|きんむ}{形態|けいたい}→勤務形態：27106_kinmukeitai⟧: employment format — more formal, refers to the structural type of employment
- {就業|しゅうぎょう}⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧: work style — a newer loanword-based expression with similar meaning
